content:
sophia: Quick life update — two tiny (giant) things: I accepted an internal promotion to Director, Developer Experience today 389 and also said yes last night 48d492!! Couldnt wait to tell you all.
omar: WHAT!!! Director 389 + engaged?! congrats x infinity!!! photos pls 60d
tess: This is the best news. Double confetti. Whens the party? I will bring cupcakes. 370
liam: Huge congrats Sophia. Also very excited to meet the future in-law(s). Fancy lunch or low-key coffee? poll: Lunch / Coffee / Evening drinks 374375react with emoji.
maya: :coffee: (but i will happily join for cake at lunch)
omar: :wine_glass: (evening drinks)
sophia: Love it — thinking a quick Friday 4pm drop-in works so folks can swing by after work. People Ops, if youre able to help with a tiny RSVP and card that would be amazing. Link placeholder for addresses: https://tinyurl.com/sophia-celebrate (just a placeholder).
people-ops-bot: Congrats Sophia! :tada: People Ops can create a 30-minute "Sophia: Promo + Engagement" event in the commons on Friday at 16:00 PT and manage a group card. React with :handshake: to have People Ops coordinate. RSVP form will be posted when event is confirmed.
tess: :handshake: I'll help with cupcakes. Also would anyone like to chip in for a group gift? React with :dollar: if so.
liam: :dollar: count me in
omar: :thumbsup: ill bring a ridiculous party hat
sophia: Thanks everyone 970. Also small ask: if anyone has recs for wedding photographers in the Bay Area DM me. And on-call friends  I might request a weekend swap around the rehearsal so heads up.
liam: I got you on swaps, just ping the on-call channel when dates are firm and Ill cover.
maya: Photographer rec: DM sent!
people-ops-bot: Reminder: please follow Redwood gift policy for teammate celebrations. People Ops can purchase a team gift if a majority react with :handshake:.
tess: Youre going to be the most stylish director and spouse ever 60d
sophia: You all are the absolute best. Feeling very lucky and so excited 618
